map.房贷等额本息/本金对比 使用指南: Mortgage Equal-Payment vs Equal-Principal Comparison User Guide
map.输入贷款总额、年限与利率，工具分别测算等额本息与等额本金两种还款方式的月供、总利: Enter the total loan, the term in years and the rate; the tool computes the monthly payment, total interest and early-stage cash pressure for both equal payment and equal principal, and shows them side by side so buyers can choose the plan that saves interest or is easier on cash flow.
map.一键对比两种还款方式的月供、总利息与资金压力: Compare the monthly payment, total interest and cash pressure of two repayment plans in one click
map.贷款前对比两种还款方式的总利息与月供压力。: Compare total interest and monthly payment pressure of two repayment plans before taking out a loan.
map.提前还款决策时看已还本金与剩余利息。: When deciding on early repayment, look at the principal already repaid and the interest remaining.
map.收入稳定家庭选等额本息、前期宽裕选等额本金。: Households with stable income should choose equal payment; those with room early on should choose equal principal.
map.：等额本息月供≈4,899 元，总利息≈76.4 万；等额本金首月≈6,278: Equal payment monthly payment about 4,899 CNY with total interest about 764,000 CNY; equal principal first month about 6,278 CNY, decreasing monthly, last month about 2,779 CNY, total interest about 632,000 CNY, saving about 130,000 CNY versus equal payment.
map.月供差多少: How Much Do the Monthly Payments Differ?
map.：同样条件下等额本金首月比等额本息高约 1,379 元，但第 10 年起月供反低: Under the same conditions the first month of equal principal is about 1,379 CNY higher than equal payment, but from year 10 the monthly payment is lower instead, which suits people who can afford the front end and want to save total interest.

map.等额本金总利息更少，但前期月供高；等额本息月供固定、总息略高，按自身现金流选，没: Equal principal charges less total interest but starts with a higher monthly payment; equal payment keeps the payment fixed with slightly higher total interest. Choose by your own cash flow; neither is absolutely better.
